description: This file defines an abstract class 'ImportDataSource' which implements the 'Iterator' interface and provides a base for importing data from external sources within the SuiteCRM platform. It contains methods for data loading, error handling, status reporting, and row processing used during data import operations.

classes.name: ImportDataSource
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for specific data source implementations in the import process, providing common functionality such as data loading, error tracking, status updates, and iteration.

methods.name: setSourceName
methods.description: Sets the source name used as an identifier for this import.

methods.name: setCurrentOffset
methods.description: Sets the current offset (pagination or position indicator) for data processing.

methods.name: getDataSet
methods.description: Returns the loaded data set segment.

methods.name: writeRowToLastImport
methods.description: Logs imported row metadata into the LastImport tracking system.

methods.name: writeError
methods.description: Logs an error related to a specific row, saves details into an error file, and formats the error message.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats a detailed error message for display or logging.

methods.name: resetRowErrorCounter
methods.description: Resets the error counter for the current row.

methods.name: writeStatus
methods.description: Writes import operation status counts to a log/status file.

methods.name: markRowAsDuplicate
methods.description: Flags the current row as a duplicate, logs it, and optionally highlights duplicate fields.

methods.name: markRowAsImported
methods.description: Flags whether the current row created or updated a record.

methods.name: writeErrorRecord
methods.description: Logs a record that encountered an error, with or without a specific error message.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter method to access request variables, locale settings, or class properties.
